label: early original-phase h/1/m/v/j/k after a s/r/f/x/d-type first token
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (99.5% of mass), at positions t=2..5 (peak t=3, 57% of mass), never at t<2 or in the copy phase, and only weakly on <DEL>. The input token must be from a small set: h (41% of mass, 11.6x lift), 1, m, then v, j, k. Nearly always the first occurrence of that token. Magnitude depends on history: it is strongest when the sequence starts with s (then r, f, x, d, t, i, g) and when s/r/x/f appear two steps back. The top activations are h at t=3 in sequences starting with s. Token set plus position gives recall 0.96 but precision only 0.18. Adding the first-token condition brings dev F1 to about 0.54 with mass recall 0.79. The rest of the history dependence (a graded function of the earlier tokens) is not captured by any simple predicate.
